notablePrerequisites: Romana II does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Mutable Explorer by paying {2}{G}.
When Mutable Explorer enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Mutavault land token.
When the Mutavault token enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Reoslve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Romana II.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a tapped copy of the Mutavault token.
Repeat from step 3.
